buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. An office of the Service Provider must be located in the state of Consignee. DOCUMENTARY EVIDENCE TO BE SUBMITTED. 2. GST Certificate should be registered in TAMILNADU. (Documentary Evidence should be submitted)

3. Office should be located in Chennai District / Tirunelveli District (Proof of GST mentioning office address s hould be submitted) 4. Bidder should have the valid labour license. (Documentary Evidence should be submitted) 5. The Service provider should submit ESIC Registration Certificate and EPF Registration Certificate. 6. Minimum AVERAGE ANNUAL TURNOVER of Rs. 25 Lakhs in the last 3 financial years. (Balance sheet/CA ce rtificate to be enclosed, duly supported by the income tax return for financial years 2023-24, 2024-25 & 2 025-26). 7. The bidder must submit the signed copy of the ATC Acceptance. 8. A Non-Blacklisting Certificate must be submitted, confirming no such actions by any government organisa tion within the last three years. 9. If the agency is registered under MSME (Micro & Small) registered as Startup under DPIIT or NSIC, then EM D exemption certificate needs to be enclosed and Bid Security Declaration Should be submitted. 10. Past experience of similar services: The bidder must have successfully executed / completed at least one single order of 80 % of the estimated bid value or 2 orders each of 50 % of the estimated bid value or 3 ord ers each of 40 % of the estimated bid value for similar service(s) in last three years to any Central / State Govt Organization / PSU / Public Listed Company. Copies of contracts / work orders and documentary evidence of successful execution / completion in support of past experience of similar services along with names, address and contact details of clients shall be uploaded with the bid for verification by the Buyer 11. Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 12. The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 50 percent at the tim e of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 50 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration 13. The bidder should not be under liquidation, court receivership or similar proceedings, should not be bankr upt. Bidder to upload undertaking to this effect with bid. 14. Payment of salary to contractual staff should be made on or before 5th of every month. 15. While submitting Original Tax invoice to office, GeM Invoice, Attendance Sheet, EPF Statement, ESI State ment, Pay Slip, salary statement and any statutory deductions should be enclosed along with the original b ill on or before 10th of every month on monthly basis. 16. Payment will be made 100% upon submission of invoice on monthly basis, in the following month through Bank. 17. EPF contribution is to be paid up to the maximum wage ceiling of Rs.25,000/- 18. Income Tax at source will be deducted as per rules. 19. Child labour is strictly prohibited and if the service provider violates them, the contract will be terminated. 20. The service provider shall ensure that they deploy only qualified personnel at site for the work. 21. The service provider should furnish the detail number of the labour employed by them for the work. 22. Antecedents verification of employee to be done by the service provider and necessary details to be furni shed. 23. ICMR-NIE reserves the right to examine the suitability of the individuals to be employed by the servi ce provider, with respect to the qualification, work knowledge and experience, in the relevant field. A ccordingly, ICMR-NIE reserves the right to reject any of the individuals to be engaged by the service provider. 24. The service provider must provide 2 sets of suitable uniforms, ID Card, Badge, Shoes / Chappals and Safet y equipment on their own (Service provider) cost for safety and shall ensure their regular usage and prope r maintenance for every year. 25. The manpower deployed by the service provider as mentioned in the bid document to be maintained and i f there is any difference in man power, the proportionate amount will be deducted from the monthly bill.

26. The service provider should pay Central Government Minimum wages under Category ‘C’ and other statut ory payments as mentioned in the Bid document. 27. Behaviour of personnel employed by the service provider shall in no way be detrimental to the administra tion. The service provider shall provide personnel of good character, physically fit, efficient, well behaved and skilful in their duties. 28. Non punctual to duty and unauthorized absence will be viewed seriously. 29. The service provider has to abide by all the terms and conditions given in the bid documents and scope of work. 30. Bidder will be eligible for revision of wages (VDA) in lien with Chief Labour Commissioner order as issue d f rom time to time. 31. Dedicated /toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support: BIDDER/OEM must have Dedicated/toll Free Telep hone No. for Service Support. 32. Proof for Past Experience and Project Experience clause: For fulfilling the experience criteria any one of th e following documents may be considered as valid proof for meeting the experience criteria: i. Contract co py along with Invoice(s) with self-certification by the bidder that service/supplies against the invoices have been executed. ii. Execution certificate by client with contract value. iii. Any other document in support of contract execution like Third Party Inspection release note, etc. 33. PAYMENT OF SALARIES AND WAGES: Service Provider is required to pay Salaries / wages of contracted sta ff deployed at buyer location first i.e. on their own and then claim payment from Buyer along with all statut ory documents like, PF, ESIC etc. as well as the bank statement of payment done to staff. 34. Successful Bidder can submit the Performance Security in the form of Account Payee Demand Draft also ( besides PBG which is allowed as per GeM GTC). DD should be made in favour of Director NIE payable at Ch ennai. After award of contract, Successful Bidder can upload scanned copy of the DD in place of PBG and h as to ensure delivery of hard copy to the original DD to the Buyer within 15 days of award of contract. 35. Successful Bidder can submit the Performance Security in the form of Payment online through RTGS / inter net banking also (besides PBG which is allowed as per GeM GTC). On-line payment shall be in Beneficiary name Director NIE Account No. 0936201002864 IFSC Code CNRB0000936 Bank Name Canara Bank Branch address Ambattur. 36. Successful Bidder to indicate Contract number and name of Seller entity in the transaction details field at the time of on-line transfer. Bidder has to upload scanned copy / proof of the Online Payment Transfer in pl ace of PBG within 15 days of award of contract. 37. The Service Provider is required to have at least 40 % of the required manpower on service provider’s pay roll for at least one year. Necessary documents relating to such manpower will be uploaded by the bidder f or verification of the buyer. Such manpower will be part of total manpower to be provided by the Service Pr ovider in case he gets the contract against this bid. 38. Pay Slip should be provided to contractual staff and the same should be submitted to this office along wit h the bill. 39. The remittance towards ESIC and EPF should be submitted every month along with the bill submitted for p ayment. 40. Failure of the successful bidder in providing performance security and / or returning contract copy duly sig ned shall make the bidder liable for forfeiture of its EMD. 41. A list of staff along with their photographs attested by the agency including permanent address should be provided to the office for record before taking over the charge of Housekeeping services. 42. Security money of the service provider will be forfeited in case of breach of any conditions stipulated in th e tender. 43. Any Charges, such as onboarding, etc., should not be collected from the individual. If, it is found that any charges collected from individual, legal action will be taken. 44. In case of breach of any of terms and conditions mentioned above, the Competent Authority will have the right to cancel the contract without assigning any reason thereof, and nothing will be payable by this insti tute in that event and the Performance Security deposit shall be encashed.

45. The service provider has to provide Photo Identity Cards to the person deployed for carrying out the work. These cards are to be always displayed. 46. The persons deployed by the Service Provider shall not claim nor shall be entitled to pay, perks and other facilities admissible to casual, ad-hoc, regular/confirmed employees of ICMR-NIE during the contract period or, after expiry of the contract. 47. ICMR-NIE reserves right to withdraw/relax any of the terms and conditions mentioned above so as to overc ome the problem encountered by the contracting parties 48. During the course of the tender process, ICMR-NIE may seek clarifications or additional documents and it i s the duty of the renderer to provide the same. 49. The persons deployed shall not be below the age of 21 years and above the age of 58 years who are in du ties of the contractor provided to ICMR-NIE. 50. The contractor must have trained drivers on their employee roll. 51. Unsatisfactory or unprofessional behaviour shall result in termination of the contract. Non-adherence to th e quality of service and terms and conditions mentioned herein shall result in termination of the contract i mmediately, with encashment of the Performance Security deposit. 52. Contractor shall be fully responsible of ICMR-NIE vehicles for theft, burglary, fire, accidents, traffic rule viol ations or any other unlawful acts/deeds by his staff. Compensation will be claimed from the contractor. 53. The contractor will provide well-behaved drivers having knowledge of different routes, as well as repair of cars and valid driving license and also having proper uniforms and name badge. 54. The driver should not be under the influence of any sort of drug or alcohol at the time of duty. Violations s hall attract a penalty. In cases where the driver is found under influence, the contractor shall make arrang ement for alternate driver immediately. 55. The drivers shall be exceptionally talented in navigating routes to destinations and shall know how to mak e good use of standard maps and the GPS. 56. The trip sheet shall be maintained by the drivers. The drivers shall be responsible for proper completion o f the log books including obtaining the signatures of the users. 57. No charges will be given for lunch/tea to the driver. Driver should carry his lunch. 58. In some cases driver must extend duty timing after completing given duties. 59. Driver(s) engaged must possess valid Public Service Driving License (LMV) with badge. 60. In normal working hours of the office shall be from 9.00A.M. to 5.30P.M. (Monday to Friday) with thirty mi nutes break. However, drivers need to attend the office even on Holidays. As per exigency on applicable c ompensation. 61. Further, driver may be required to arrive 30 minutes before office time and depart 30 minutes after office time. 62. a. The Seller shall not assign the Contract in whole or part without obtaining the prior written consent of b uyer. b. The Seller shall not sub-contract the Contract in whole or part to any entity without obtaining the prior w ritten consent of buyer. c. The Seller shall, notwithstanding the consent and assignment/sub-contract, remain jointly and severally l iable and responsible to buyer together with the assignee/ sub-service provider, for and in respect of the d ue performance of the Contract and the Sellers obligations there under. .
